blocks.text: This document is designed as a standardized test fixture for verifying document parsing engines. It includes layered heading hierarchies, identical duplicate titles for anchor disambiguation testing, data tables, code snippets, and placeholder chips.
This section tests how deep the parser can traverse nested heading levels without losing parent-child context or breaking document trees.
High-level container section representing the root component layer.
Data processing stage responsible for payload reception and streaming batch validation.
Core module responsible for transforming structural text into clean Abstract Syntax Trees (AST).
Sub-component responsible for lexical analysis and text segmentation.
Deepest nested node testing parsing depth limits for H6 elements.
First top-level instance of the heading Overview. Parsers should assign this node a unique anchor ID (e.g., overview or overview-1).
Configuration parameters scoped under the primary Overview node.
Performance indicators associated with the initial pipeline ingestion stage.
Secondary top-level section containing repeated sub-heading titles to test scoped anchor disambiguation across different parent branches.
, scoped directly under the Performance parent section. Parsers should disambiguate this from the previous top-level Overview node.

| raw_text | String | Optional | Unescaped text content prior to formatting strip |
| is_duplicate | Boolean | System Flag | Boolean set when heading title collision occurs |
